derivation: from a derivative of (to range in regular line);
strongs_def: to march in (military) rank (keep step), i.e. (figuratively) to conform to virtue and piety
it_def:
1) procedere in una fila come soldati in marcia, andare in ordine
   1a) metaforicamente continuare prosperosamente, risultare bene
2) camminare
   2a) dirigere la propria vita, condursi, vivere
